why: A TAG raise: `fulfillments:created_by.name` and `fulfillments:updated_by.name` are pii `mask` leaves the old floor (beta.386) did not have, so a build at .386 would write those names to git unmasked. `deno task lint:capture-floor` names beta.550 as the earliest version carrying every current tag AND routing them the same way (it verified beta.549 does not), which is why the floor is .550 and not the version that first introduced the tags (templates#251). ⚠️ Verified against the deployment, not assumed: on 2026-10-08 prod serves api-cloudrun-00489-9fz = v0.334.2, whose deno.json pins 10.0.0-beta.634, above this floor. Re-read the running pin before assuming that is still true. Subsumes beta.386's raise (core#91/#92/#93: the light-shape org refs' `organization_path[].name` leaves and the subject-seeded fake) and every mask below it.
see: api-cloudrun#838 — a capture is sanitized by the DEPLOYED api's @cfs/core, and no repository holds that fact. captureFixture reads THIS file from the base branch and refuses to sanitize with an older build. templates#213 — `deno task lint:capture-floor` detects a floor that has fallen BELOW the masks that exist; it deliberately does not object to one raised ABOVE them, which is what this floor is. templates#155 — why a floor raised above the deployed core is safe HERE specifically: the family PR that needs it is already blocked on the same release by the deployed-enums lint. api-cloudrun#712 — the Org Statement and the AR Aging report, whose template families are what make `statements` and `aging-reports` capturable sources. Raise min_core ONLY to a version api-cloudrun has DEPLOYED, or every capture is refused until it does — read the running pin off `/openapi.json`'s info.version, map it to a release tag, and read that tag's deno.json.
